name: a fact dated after the day of the pull
why: A fact cannot be true as of a day that has not happened yet. A stamp ahead of the day of the pull is a clock, a time zone or a typo, and the page would show a reader a date in the future with nothing downstream in a position to notice. Refused (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026). The rows here are the ordinary ones; it is the day of the pull that is earlier than they are.
fails: is dated after the day of the pull (2026-10-20)
